name: Spider-Man
tagline: Your friendly neighbourhood original.
description: A sharp-witted Queens kid who turned a radioactive spider bite into a lifelong promise to help people. Peter's mix of science, stubborn optimism and responsibility makes him the benchmark for every Spider-hero who followed.

name: Miles Morales
tagline: A new generation. A different kind of Spider-Man.
description: Brooklyn-born Miles steps into the Spider-Man legacy after the Peter Parker of his world falls. His unique bio-electric abilities and camouflage give him a style all his own, while his sense of responsibility connects him to the wider Spider-family.

name: Spider-Man 2099
tagline: The future has fangs.
description: In a corporate-controlled future, geneticist Miguel O'Hara becomes a very different Spider-Man. His DNA rewrite grants him talons, enhanced senses and organic webbing, turning him into a formidable protector of 2099.

name: Spider-Punk
tagline: No gods. No masters. No surrender.
description: Hobie Brown is the rebellious Spider-Man of a dystopian Earth. A punk-rock activist who fights oppressive power, he brings the classic spider toolkit to the streets with a guitar, a loud voice and absolutely no interest in behaving.

name: Spider-Ham
tagline: That's all, folks. The web is still strong.
description: A spider-turned-pig from a cartoon universe, Peter Porker is proof that the multiverse has a sense of humour. Under the gags and elastic physics is a genuine hero with the same big-hearted instinct to save the day.

name: Silk
tagline: Same spider. A whole new story.
description: Cindy Moon was bitten by the same radioactive spider that changed Peter Parker. After years in hiding, she emerges as Silk: a fast, instinctive hero with organic webbing and a powerful connection to the spider-totem network.

name: Spider-Man Noir
tagline: In the shadows, the web still holds.
description: A hard-boiled Spider-Man from a Depression-era New York. After a supernatural spider encounter, this Peter Parker takes on gangsters and corruption with grit, detective instincts and a decidedly noir point of view.

name: Spider-UK
tagline: The web has a British address.
description: A member of the Captain Britain Corps, Billy Braddock discovers the Inheritors' hunt across realities and helps form the Web Warriors. He is a multiverse-hopping leader who brings a distinctly British spin to the Spider mantle.

name: Spider-Gwen
tagline: One beat ahead of the multiverse.
description: On Earth-65, the radioactive spider bites Gwen Stacy instead of Peter Parker. Gwen becomes Spider-Woman, balancing hero work with life as a drummer while navigating a world that does not always trust its masked protector.

name: Scarlet Spider
tagline: A clone with a hero's heart.
description: Ben Reilly is one of the Jackal's most successful Spider-Man clones. He forges his own identity as the Scarlet Spider, using his scientific know-how, custom web gadgets and determination to prove that a copy can still be his own person.

name: Spider-Man India
tagline: Mumbai has its own friendly neighbourhood Spider-Man.
description: Pavitr Prabhakar protects his home reality with a Spider-Man legacy shaped by Mumbai. After receiving his abilities from a mysterious yogi, he learns that great power comes with responsibility and becomes part of the wider Spider-Army.

name: SP//dr
tagline: One pilot. One spider. One formidable machine.
description: Peni Parker is the young pilot of SP//dr, a powerful mech linked to a radioactive spider companion. Together they defend their world through a unique bond that combines quick thinking, advanced engineering and the strength of a giant robotic suit.
imageCredit: Marvel Rivals character portrait / Peni Parker and SP//dr

name: Spider-Woman
tagline: A different kind of spider-powerhouse.
description: Jessica Drew forged her own identity as Spider-Woman after an unusual childhood treatment involving irradiated spider material. An experienced investigator and field operative, she pairs classic spider abilities with powerful bioelectric blasts.

name: Spider-Girl
tagline: The next Parker generation takes the leap.
description: Mayday Parker is the daughter of Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson in the MC2 future. She discovers her father's legacy and chooses to carry it forward as Spider-Girl, building a heroic identity of her own.

name: Araña
tagline: The Spider Society has a new kind of hunter.
description: Anya Corazon's powers are tied to an ancient Spider Society and a mystical bond. Her spider-mark can manifest protective carapace armour, while her strength, agility and fighting skill make her a formidable member of the Web-Warriors.

name: Spider-Byte
tagline: The web is more than a metaphor.
description: Margo Kess operates as Spider-Byte through a digital avatar in a virtual dimension. Her command of networked spaces and advanced technology makes her a valuable guide through the multiverse's connected systems.
imageCredit: Margo Kess / Spider-Byte film still and Kris Anka character design

name: Web-Slinger
tagline: The frontier has a masked guardian.
description: Patrick O’Hara is a Wild West Spider-hero whose world trades skyscrapers for dusty frontier towns. He brings a western gunslinger's nerve to the familiar Spider-hero mission, swinging into danger wherever justice needs a hand.
imageCredit: Web-Slinger character design by Kris Anka

name: Spider-Rex
tagline: Prehistoric power. Spider-sized responsibility.
description: Pter Ptarker is a dinosaur-sized Spider-hero from a world where the Spider-totem takes a very different shape. Spider-Rex combines a powerful prehistoric build with the instincts and web-based tricks of a wall-crawler.

name: Sun-Spider
tagline: A bright spark with a web of her own.
description: Charlotte Webber is Sun-Spider, a creative and resourceful hero who brings her own style to the Spider-Verse. She uses web-based movement, acrobatic skill and inventive thinking to protect the people around her.
imageCredit: Sun-Spider artwork by Dayn Broder / Kris Anka character design

name: Spider-Boy
tagline: A new partner with a very unusual origin.
description: Bailey Briggs is a young human-spider hybrid with a history that was hidden from the wider world. As Spider-Boy, he brings unusual spider physiology, sharp instincts and a distinctive place in the growing Spider-family.

name: Lady Spider
tagline: Victorian ingenuity meets the Spider-Verse.
description: Maybelle Reilly is a brilliant inventor from an alternate 1895 New York. Without relying on a standard Spider-Man suit, she uses ingenious mechanical spider-limbs and custom-built equipment to take on threats in her steampunk world.
imageCredit: Lady Spider / Maybelle Reilly character artwork

name: Spider-Man 1602
tagline: A spider born in the age of discovery.
description: Peter Parquagh is a reimagined Spider-Man from Marvel's 1602 setting, where extraordinary beings appear in an Elizabethan world. Known as the Spider, he brings a web-slinger's instincts to a world of royal intrigue, strange science and swashbuckling adventure.

name: Six-Armed Spider-Man
tagline: More arms. More ways to save the day.
description: In this alternate reality, Peter Parker's attempt to remove his spider-powers goes very wrong, leaving him with four additional arms. The mutation changes his silhouette and fighting style, but not his determination to protect New York.

name: Superior Spider-Man
tagline: A new mind behind the familiar mask.
description: Otto Octavius takes over Peter Parker's body and decides to become a more efficient, more ruthless Spider-Man. His scientific brilliance and willingness to upgrade the role make the Superior Spider-Man a very different interpretation of the familiar hero.

name: Cosmic Spider-Man
tagline: The power of the cosmos in a Spider's hands.
description: Peter Parker of Earth-13 becomes that reality's Captain Universe after being chosen by the Enigma Force. The cosmic power makes him one of the most formidable Spider-heroes, though its full strength is tied to his home universe.
imageCredit: Cosmic Spider-Man / Captain Universe comic artwork

name: Japanese Spider-Man
tagline: A hero, a spacecraft and a giant robot.
description: Takuya Yamashiro is the tokusatsu Spider-Man, a racing driver who gains spider-like powers and access to the alien spacecraft Marveller. When the threat demands it, the ship transforms into the giant robot Leopardon.
imageCredit: Marvel official Japanese Spider-Man key art
